comment: Boundary probes for material cross-language concurrency contracts versus trivial async syntax, focused Rust async ownership, and unknown-cause diagnosis.

queries.query: Use $concurrency-engineering to bound this worker pipeline, define cancellation precedence, and prove every accepted operation is terminal before shutdown returns.
This callback source overwhelms a slower async iterator and remains subscribed after the consumer exits. Add a bounded pressure policy and terminal teardown.
Rename this private async helper and update its two call sites; no lifecycle or behavior changes.
The test sometimes hangs in CI and we do not know whether concurrency is involved. Diagnose the cause.
Fix cancellation safety in this Tokio future and preserve its runtime-specific pinning and task-local contracts.
Repair this Java worker pool: bound admission, stop blocked submitters after failure, propagate interruption according to its API, and join every worker before close returns.
The bottleneck is already localized. Select a bounded parallel worker count that raises throughput while preserving p99, memory, complete work accounting, and clean shutdown.
